name: topology_acquire_lock
description: Acquire an exclusive lease-based lock on a node or resource to prevent race conditions with other agents. Uses local Git-style lockfile with auto-expiration (TTL).

nodeId.description: Node or resource ID to lock

agentId.description: ID of the agent claiming the lock

ttlSeconds.description: Duration of the lock lease in seconds before auto-expiration (default: 60)

reason.description: Purpose or operation description for holding the lock
